headings: Venus Went Retrograde. And Something From Your Past Just Started Moving Again.
paragraphs: Venus Went Retrograde. And Something From Your Past Just Started Moving Again.
Right now, Venus — the planet that governs love, longing, and every connection that has ever mattered to you — is moving in reverse.
This is why someone's name has been crossing your mind. Why an old feeling returned without warning. Why something in your love life suddenly feels unresolved again.
It isn't nostalgia. It's the retrograde.
And during this window, the signal it's sending you is at its clearest — but only until Venus stations direct again.
